Project overview

A 2023 BR41N.IO experiment exploring whether EEG responses to flashing rows and columns could identify an attended character. The browser experience is a later educational simulation, separate from historical model inference.

Interactive case study

Explore the brain-typing simulation, four-step P300 explanation, historical EEG visualizations and original hackathon archive in the linked case study.

Evaluation limits

Saved code confirms GRU implementations. Historical metrics have not been independently reproduced or tied to an exact GRU configuration. No controlled GRU/LSTM speed or accuracy comparison was established.

My contribution

Processed EEG recordings, explored GRU-based classifiers, and investigated prediction performance and processing time alongside the team.
